messages.text:
Depends on where it runs and your budget, but two picks cover most people.

Magic Miner 40T, $799, 40 TH/s at about 650W, tunable 30 to 50. Best value per terahash we sell. Ships November 14, 2026.

Harlo B30, $899, 30 TH/s at 360 to 450W, quieter and gentler on a home circuit. Ships October 30, 2026.

If you want something now instead of a pre-sale, say so and I'll show what's in stock. Where will it run, and roughly what do you pay per kWh?

Good, India is on our Rest of World shipping, so both are buyable.

For a home in India I'd lean Magic Miner 40T at $799. It takes 100-240V, so it runs fine on your 230V, and in Eco mode it's 30 TH/s at 450W if you want to keep the power bill and the heat down. About 50 dB, so fine in a spare room, not a bedroom. Ships November 14, 2026.

What do you pay per unit of electricity? I'll run your actual numbers.
